detail.title: Dahua Traffic Signal Controller
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITRTSC-036B-HS-YKQ Dahua Traffic Signal Controller Key Points • Supports 36-channels Signal Light Access • Self-Adaptive Flow Control • Flexible Modular Design • IP66 Waterproof • Easy-to-Use Management Interface Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Function.Flasher: Standard hardware flasher, independent on program control
Function.Types of Phases: 16 parent phases and 16 overlap phases. Supports repeat running of parent phase, meeting requirements of repeat timing in a cycle and independent parameter settings
Function.Multi-period Timing: Up to 112 daily schemes, 48 pretimed periods, 30 weekly schemes, 30 daily dispatch schemes, and 30 special dispatch schemes
Function.Pedestrian Crossing: Input and output of up to 8 pedestrian pushbuttons
Function.Actuated Control: Up to 16-channel coils and 64-channel traffic enforcement cameras. Two detecting devices (include camera, coil, and more) can be used for detecting one lane
Function.Signal Control Mode: Manual control, pretimed control, cableless link control, actuated control, pedestrian crossing coordination control
Function.Manual Control: Manual control and remote control through host computer or central platform to meet on-site requirements
Function.Change of Control Modes: Natural change between manual control and automatic control (pretimed control, actuated control, and more)
Function.Cableless Link Control: Yes. Coordination control is realized by GPS time synchronization and setting offset
Function.Temporary Scheme: Supports configuring or clearing temporary schemes through platform
Function.Default Light Color: Default light colors include all red, flashing yellow, light off, and red flashing. Default light color displays when no phase is running in a scheme or no channel is configured
Function.Special Status: Supports special status control of traffic lights, such as all red, flashing yellow, light off, and red flashing
Function.Count down: Self-learning, pulse, and RS-485 communication countdown timers. Supports setting baud rate when using RS-485 communication countdown timer
Function.Timing: Network Sync; GPS; NTP; Manual Time Adjustment
Function.Phase: Separately set parameters of phase for cycle schemes and repeated phase. Each cycle scheme can be set with different phase parameters
Function.Auto Phase Timing: When adjusting a cycle, set the total cycle length, and the phases will be timed automatically according to the split (the ratio of phase time and cycle length in a cycle)
Function.Failure Detection: Degradation mechanism in case of green conflict and light fault; independent hardware yellow flashing control; fault information upload and search
Function.Access Control Monitoring: Supports door open/close monitoring and reporting
Function.Network Control: Communicates with host computer or central platform through network; supports setting temporary scheme and special tasks on platform
Function.Information Security: Identity authentication, control order verification, update verification of operation parameters, and broadcast storm protection
Function.Parameters Configuration: Supports setting control parameters on PC client and remote server
Function.Lighting: Yes, supports door open/close and lighting linkage
Function.Voltage Monitoring: Monitoring and display of input voltage, input current, and overall power consumption
Function.Temperature and Humidity Monitoring: Reports temperature and humidity to platform

Port.Control Switch: 1 main power switch, 1 controller switch, 1 signal light control switch, 1 flasher switch, and 1 lighting switch
Port.Network Port: 3 RJ-45 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports: 1 on the main control board, and 2 on the communication control board

General.Voltage Withstanding: 1500 VAC, 50 Hz (1500 VAC, 50 Hz voltage is applied between the power electrode or other conductive circuits connected to the power electrode and easily accessible parts such as cabinets and installation casing)
General.Protective Features: Mains lightning protection; network lightning protection; electromagnetic immunity (no electrical failure in electromagnetic disturbance environments such as electrostatic discharge, fast electrical transient bursts, surges, and short-term voltage interruptions); waterproof (passed rain test. The signal controller works normally during and after the test, and there is no water seepage or accumulation inside the signal controller); dustproof (during and after the dust test, the signal controller works normally, and there is no large amount of dust inside the signal controller); corrosion (the signal controller works normally after the salt spraying test, and there is no serious corrosion of metal components such as the signal controller casing and internal rack); passed vibration test and steel ball impact test
